as_told.title: Reverse engineering of a laser weapon from a downed Russian NHI spaceship

plain: In a conversation between a podcast host, Jesse Michels, and a filmmaker named Jeremy Corbell, they speak of an unnamed person who worked on reverse engineering, that is taking apart to learn how it works, a laser weapon system. Michels says it came from a downed Russian "asset." Corbell puts it more strongly: he says it came from a downed Russian spaceship built by non-human intelligence. If true, it would mean Russia had recovered such a craft and the US had studied its weapon.
